main.title: Broadcom Helps CPU And XPU Makers Go Vertical With Compute
main.body:
Broadcom is facilitating 3D chip stacking technology that enables CPU and XPU manufacturers to integrate multiple computing components vertically within a single socket. This approach, called 3.5D Extreme Dimension System in Package (XDSiP), significantly reduces power consumption and latency compared to traditional off-chip interconnections.

The technology achieves almost an order of magnitude larger signal density—approximately 14,000 signals per square millimeter—compared to face-to-back 3D approaches. The chief advantage involves using face-to-face bonding where metal layers align naturally, requiring only bonding agents rather than specialized architectural modifications.

Multiple companies are adopting XDSiP stacking, including Fujitsu with its upcoming Monaka Arm server CPU featuring 144 cores across 2-nanometer and 5-nanometer chiplets. At least one of six XPU makers utilizing this technology is expected to ship products in late 2026, with others following in 2027.

The approach enables designers to place high-performance compute on top dies for better heat dissipation while positioning SRAM and lower-activity components below. Two of the six XPU makers should be Amazon Web Services with its Trainium4 due at the end of this year and Meta Platforms with its MTIA 500 also due in 2027.

Broadcom's 3.5D XDSiP platform is positioned as a key enabler for the next generation of custom AI accelerators, allowing hyperscaler customers to push performance density limits while managing thermal budgets more effectively.

main.title: Astera Labs Extends Leadership in Open, AI Scale-Up Networking with New 320 Lane Scorpio X-Series Smart Fabric Switch
main.body:
Astera Labs (Nasdaq: ALAB) today announced the Scorpio X-Series 320 Lane Smart Fabric Switch, the industry's largest open, memory-semantic fabric switch engineered to improve token economics and support large-scale scale-up clusters with minimal latency.

CEO Jitendra Mohan stated: The Scorpio X-Series 320 Lane high-radix AI fabric switch replaces multiple legacy switches to enable larger scale-up cluster sizes in a single hop.

Key product highlights include support for increased cluster sizes with minimal latency, hardware-accelerated Hypercast and In-Network Compute engines that boost collective operations by up to 2x, and an expanded Scorpio P-Series spanning 32 to 320 lane configurations.

The switch begins shipping into a merchant scale-up switch silicon market projected to reach $20 billion by 2030, with production ramping in the second half of 2026. The company plans to showcase the technology at Computex 2026 in Taipei (June 2–5).

Astera Labs also collaborated on UALink 2.0 specification development. The Intelligent Connectivity Platform integrates CXL, Ethernet, NVLink Fusion, PCIe, and UALink semiconductor-based technologies with the COSMOS software suite to unify diverse components into cohesive, flexible systems delivering end-to-end scale-up and scale-out connectivity.

main.select_reason: MangoBoost DPU/SmartNIC와 가장 직접 경합하는 Tier-2 경쟁사의 플래그십 발표 — UALink/CXL/PCIe 통합 패브릭의 산업 표준화 신호로 직원 주목도 최상위.

main.title: [이슈플러스] 없어서 못파는 반도체, 삼성이 안 만들면 중국이 모두 가져간다
main.body:
삼성전자의 잠재적 파업이 AI 칩 경쟁의 결정적 시기에 글로벌 반도체 공급망을 위협하고 있다.

생산 영향: 8시간 야간 교대 한 번의 중단만으로 파운드리 생산이 58.1%, 메모리 생산이 18.4% 하락한 것으로 파악됐다. 예고된 18일간의 파업은 약 30조 원의 손실을 초래할 것으로 추정된다.

시장 맥락: 삼성의 선단 공정 라인은 현재 풀가동 중이다. 회사는 최근 HBM4 칩 양산을 시작했으며, 2026년을 통틀어 수요가 공급을 초과할 것으로 예상한다. 업계 관계자에 따르면 중국을 제외하고 HBM을 공급할 수 있는 기업은 전 세계에 3곳뿐이라며 생산 연속성 유지의 시급성을 강조했다.

중국의 우위: 중국 경쟁업체들이 정부 지원을 받아 빠르게 확장하고 있다. CXMT의 D램 시장점유율은 3%에서 5%로 증가했으며, 내년에는 10%에 달할 것으로 예상된다. YMTC의 낸드 플래시 출하량은 2025년 3분기 13% 시장점유율에 도달했다.

전문가들은 생산 중단이 당장의 재무 손실을 넘어 고객들의 삼성에 대한 신뢰를 훼손해 중국 제조업체들에게 이익을 주고 한국의 반도체 산업 전체의 신뢰성을 해칠 수 있다고 경고했다.

main.title: Amazon buys office and data center site in Maryland from T. Rowe
main.body:
Amazon has acquired an office and data center property in Maryland, purchased from financial services firm T. Rowe Price. The acquisition is part of Amazon Web Services' ongoing expansion of its physical infrastructure footprint in the eastern United States.

AWS operated 56.84 million square feet of data center and office space in 2025, according to regulatory filings. The company's custom chip portfolio—including Graviton CPUs, Trainium AI accelerators, and Nitro DPUs—has surpassed a $20 billion annual revenue run rate, growing at triple-digit rates.

Amazon has deployed more than 2.1 million AI chips over the past year, with Trainium accounting for more than half. AWS and Anthropic have inked a deal to deliver an additional 1 gigawatt of Trainium2 and Trainium3 chips by the end of 2026. The Maryland acquisition adds capacity to support continued growth in its AI infrastructure and cloud services business.

main.title: Microsoft confirms plans for data center in Tyrone, Georgia
main.body:
Microsoft has confirmed plans to build a new data center campus in Tyrone, Georgia, adding to its aggressive expansion of AI infrastructure capacity across the United States.

The Tyrone facility is part of Microsoft's commitment to doubling its AI infrastructure capacity within two years. CEO Satya Nadella confirmed the company added 1 gigawatt of additional capacity in the March quarter and reaffirmed the two-year doubling target.

Microsoft has raised its calendar 2026 capital expenditure forecast to $190 billion, with the company's AI business achieving a $37 billion annualized run rate representing 123% year-over-year growth. The Tyrone data center will eventually house the company's Cobalt ARM-based server chips and Maia 200 AI accelerators.

main.title: Huawei AI Chip Sales Target Grows as China Cuts Nvidia Use
main.body:
Huawei aims to reach $12 billion in AI chip sales during 2026 as Chinese companies redirect procurement away from Nvidia toward domestic alternatives. The shift reflects supply security concerns driven by U.S. export controls on advanced semiconductor technology.

Chinese buyers increasingly prioritize supply certainty over benchmark performance when selecting accelerators. DeepSeek's V4 model launch and stronger demand for Huawei's Ascend processors signal accelerating adoption of domestic infrastructure. Morgan Stanley projects China's AI chip market could reach $67 billion by 2030.

Huawei's accelerator revenue could still rise 60% or more this year, even if buyers keep Nvidia systems in parts of their fleets. Nvidia's share of China's AI GPU market has fallen from about 95% to zero, according to CEO Jensen Huang, due to several rounds of U.S. export controls.

The U.S. Commerce Department's April 2026 restrictions on equipment shipments to Hua Hong—China's second-largest chipmaker—create bottlenecks. Huawei lost TSMC access in January 2026, making domestic fabrication capacity the limiting factor for achieving sales targets despite robust customer demand.

main.select_reason: NVIDIA 中점유율 95%→0% + Huawei $12B 목표는 분리된 AI 인프라 생태계의 정량적 확정 — Korean semi 정책·공급망 전망에 직접 영향.

main.title: ASML CEO Christophe Fouquet on his company's monopoly: no one is coming for us
main.body:
ASML dominates the semiconductor equipment industry as the sole manufacturer of extreme ultraviolet (EUV) lithography machines—devices costing $200–400 million each that are essential for producing advanced chips. The Dutch company's monopoly has driven its valuation above $530 billion.

CEO Christophe Fouquet downplayed startup rival Substrate's ambitions, arguing that successfully manufacturing these machines requires decades of accumulated expertise. He noted that being able to make an image is a starting point, but scaling production demands nanometer accuracy and enormous capital investment.

Fouquet acknowledged that demand significantly outpaces supply, with hyperscalers unlikely to receive sufficient chips for the next two, three, even five years. Regarding China's potential reverse-engineering efforts, Fouquet stated definitively that no EUV machines have been exported there, making such claims simply wrong.

On TSMC's concerns about expensive high-NA systems, Fouquet countered that despite higher equipment costs, the machines deliver 20%–30% cost reduction per wafer. The CEO also co-signed an opinion piece on May 5 with other European technology companies on semiconductor policy.

ASML now sees 2026 net sales to be between 36 billion euros and 40 billion euros, following a 36% stock appreciation year-to-date driven by AI chipmaker demand.

main.title: Nebius, Lambda, and CoreWeave unlikely to buy Google TPUs any time soon
main.body:
GPU cloud providers Nebius, Lambda, and CoreWeave are unlikely to become customers for Google's Tensor Processing Units (TPUs) in the near term, despite Google's announcement of a TPU sales program for external customers.

Google announced at its Cloud Next 2026 event in April that it would begin selling eighth-generation TPUs—the TPU 8t for training and TPU 8i for inference—to select external customers. However, neo-cloud providers that have built business models around NVIDIA hardware face significant software ecosystem lock-in challenges when evaluating alternative compute platforms.

The TPU 8t and 8i represent Google's first bifurcated architecture, with training and inference chips optimized for their respective workloads. The TPU 8t delivers 12.6 FP4 PFLOPs and 216GB HBM3e memory, while the TPU 8i targets high-speed serving with 10.1 FP4 PFLOPs and 288GB HBM3e.

Analysts note that while hyperscalers like Microsoft Azure, AWS, and Meta would be logical first-tier customers for Google's TPUs, the neo-cloud segment remains predominantly NVIDIA-centric due to software compatibility requirements and customer demand for familiar tooling.

main.title: Micron 6600 ION 245TB SSD Announced
main.body:
Micron has unveiled a new capacity milestone for its 6600 ION NVMe SSD lineup. The company introduced a 245.76TB version of the Micron 6600 ION, enabling data center platforms to leverage nearly a quarter petabyte of storage in a single drive.

The 6600 ION represents Micron's capacity-optimized PCIe Gen5 data center SSD line, constructed using Micron G9 QLC NAND technology. Previously, the family offered a 122.88TB E3.S option. The new 245.76TB model expands availability to both E3.L and U.2 form factors. This drive targets environments prioritizing storage density per rack and power efficiency per terabyte, including AI data lakes, hyperscale storage, and analytics clusters.

The drive delivers up to 13.7 GB/s for sequential reads and 3.0 GB/s for sequential writes, up to 1.78 million random read IOPS, and a maximum power rating of 30W. According to Micron's specifications, the E3.S 122TB configuration stores over 2.4PB per 1U, while the E3.L 245TB version achieves over 3.9PB per 1U.

Micron's analysis compares a 1EB deployment using 245.76TB E3.L SSDs against traditional 44TB hard drives, demonstrating a 5.6x reduction in rack space.

main.select_reason: 245.76TB QLC SSD로 1U당 3.9PB 신기록 — MangoBoost 스토리지 가속 인접 영역, products 다양화 기여.

main.title: Applied Materials Completes ASMPT NEXX Acquisition, Secures ECD Technology
main.body:
Applied Materials has finalized its agreement to acquire ASMPT's NEXX division, a semiconductor advanced packaging equipment business unit. The acquisition adds electrochemical deposition (ECD) technology capabilities to Applied Materials' portfolio.

NEXX specializes in ECD equipment like the Stratus P500, which deposits metal films by submerging substrates in electrolyte solution and applying electrical current. This complements Applied Materials' existing panel-level package (PLP) technology.

The combined technology portfolio enables co-optimized solutions for AI chip manufacturing. These solutions allow process equipment to share data across manufacturing stages, improving efficiency and accelerating advanced packaging adoption timelines.

This technology performs semiconductor packaging on rectangular panels (510×515mm), offering greater throughput than traditional 300mm wafers—beneficial for larger AI accelerator chips. The acquisition requires no additional regulatory approval and should close within several months. NEXX operations will integrate into Applied Materials' Semiconductor Products Group while maintaining R&D activities at the Massachusetts headquarters.

Broadcom has secured partnerships with at least six major hyperscalers for its 3.5D XDSiP packaging technology and custom ASIC development. At a P/E ratio of 82, the stock appears expensive on the surface, but a price-to-earnings-growth (PEG) ratio of 2.0 suggests the stock's valuation is quite reasonable for the growth you're expecting.

Six major chip deals are currently ramping up, positioning Broadcom for substantial near-term expansion. CEO Hock Tan noted that AI revenue could grow to well above $100 billion by the end of next year. Broadcom stock has shot up an impressive 34% over the past month.

The company earned $20 billion from its AI business in 2025, driven primarily by custom AI ASIC (XPU) designs for hyperscaler customers. Broadcom's AI revenues surged 106% year-over-year in Q1 FY2026, reaching $8.4 billion.

competitor_articles.title: OpenAI's cozy partner Cerebras is on track for a blockbuster IPO
competitor_articles.body:
Cerebras Systems is preparing for a major initial public offering, planning to sell 28 million shares priced between $115–$125 each. This offering would raise approximately $3.5 billion and value the company at $26.6 billion at the high end—a significant increase from its $23 billion valuation just months earlier during its Series H funding round in February.

The AI chip manufacturer produces the Wafer-Scale Engine 3, designed to compete with GPU-based AI chips while offering improved inference speed and reduced power consumption. OpenAI maintains a notably deep relationship with Cerebras as one of its largest customers, having extended a $1 billion loan secured by warrants permitting potential ownership of over 33 million shares.

The offering would represent the largest tech IPO of 2026 so far, with substantial investor demand already evident—banks are already fielding $10 billion worth of orders for the $3.5 billion worth of shares on offer. Major shareholders include Alpha Wave, Benchmark, Eclipse, Fidelity, and Foundation Capital, alongside prominent angel investors from the tech industry including OpenAI executives Sam Altman and Greg Brockman.

The shares are to be traded under the ticker symbol CBRS on the Nasdaq Global Select Market.
competitor_articles.keep_reason: Cerebras IPO 본격화 — 가치 $26.6B, $3.5B 조달, OpenAI $1B 대출/워런트 + AWS 공급계약. 인접 AI 가속기 시장의 자본·고객 검증 신호.

competitor_articles.title: '엔비디아 대항마' 세레브라스, 38조 기업 가치로 IPO 도전
competitor_articles.body:
AI 칩 스타트업 세레브라스(Cerebras)가 기업가치 266억 달러(약 38조 원) 목표로 미국 나스닥 상장을 추진하고 있다. 회사는 주당 115~125달러 범위로 2800만 주를 공모해 약 35억 달러(약 5조 원)를 조달한다는 내용의 투자설명서를 제출했다. 모건스탠리, 씨티그룹, 바클레이즈, UBS가 주관사로 나선다.

이는 세레브라스가 지난해 10월 상장 계획을 철회한 이후 두 번째 도전이다. 세레브라스는 연산과 메모리를 대형 실리콘 기판에 통합한 '웨이퍼 스케일 엔진(WSE)' 칩으로 유명하다. 이 기술은 AI 모델 학습과 추론 속도를 대폭 높인다.

재무 성과: 2025년 매출 5억1000만 달러(약 7300억 원, 전년 2억9000만 달러 대비 급증), 주당 순이익 1.38달러로 흑자 전환. 2026년 2월 타이거글로벌 주도 펀딩 라운드에서 기업가치 230억 달러로 평가받았다.

전략적 파트너십: 오픈AI와 750MW AI 컴퓨팅 인프라 제공 계약(20억 달러 이상), 아마존 웹 서비스(AWS)와 칩 공급 계약 체결. 오픈AI 설립자 샘 알트먼과 그레그 브록먼도 엔젤 투자자로 참여. 주요 기관 투자자는 알파 웨이브, 벤치마크, 이클립스, 피델리티, 파운데이션 캐피털 등이다.
competitor_articles.keep_reason: Cerebras IPO 한국어 정리본 — 38조 원 기업가치, 750MW OpenAI 인프라 계약($2B+), AWS 공급, 2025 매출 $510M 흑자전환 등 한국 독자용 1차 정리.

competitor_articles.title: Nebius, Lambda, and CoreWeave unlikely to buy Google TPUs any time soon
competitor_articles.body:
GPU cloud providers Nebius, Lambda, and CoreWeave are unlikely to become customers for Google's Tensor Processing Units (TPUs) in the near term, despite Google's announcement of a TPU sales program for external customers.

Google announced at its Cloud Next 2026 event in April that it would begin selling eighth-generation TPUs—the TPU 8t for training and TPU 8i for inference—to select external customers. However, neo-cloud providers that have built business models around NVIDIA hardware face significant software ecosystem lock-in challenges when evaluating alternative compute platforms.

The TPU 8t and 8i represent Google's first bifurcated architecture, with training and inference chips optimized for their respective workloads. The TPU 8t delivers 12.6 FP4 PFLOPs and 216GB HBM3e memory, while the TPU 8i targets high-speed serving with 10.1 FP4 PFLOPs and 288GB HBM3e.

Analysts note that while hyperscalers like Microsoft Azure, AWS, and Meta would be logical first-tier customers for Google's TPUs, the neo-cloud segment remains predominantly NVIDIA-centric due to software compatibility requirements and customer demand for familiar tooling.
competitor_articles.keep_reason: Google TPU 8t/8i 외부 판매 vs neo-cloud의 NVIDIA 소프트웨어 락인 — 대안 가속기 채택 장벽과 시장 분절 구조 분석. MangoBoost의 다양한 가속기 활용 전략에 직결.

competitor_articles.title: Microsoft confirms plans for data center in Tyrone, Georgia
competitor_articles.body:
Microsoft has confirmed plans to build a new data center campus in Tyrone, Georgia, adding to its aggressive expansion of AI infrastructure capacity across the United States.

The Tyrone facility is part of Microsoft's commitment to doubling its AI infrastructure capacity within two years. CEO Satya Nadella confirmed the company added 1 gigawatt of additional capacity in the March quarter and reaffirmed the two-year doubling target.

Microsoft has raised its calendar 2026 capital expenditure forecast to $190 billion, with the company's AI business achieving a $37 billion annualized run rate representing 123% year-over-year growth. The Tyrone data center will eventually house the company's Cobalt ARM-based server chips and Maia 200 AI accelerators.
competitor_articles.keep_reason: MS Cobalt ARM CPU + Maia 200 AI 가속기 배치 예정 + 2026 capex $190B — 하이퍼스케일러 자체 실리콘 인프라 확장의 결정적 데이터포인트.

competitor_articles.title: "통제 불능 섀도우 AI 막는다"...MS, 사내 거버넌스 플랫폼 '에이전트 365' 출시
competitor_articles.body:
마이크로소프트(Microsoft)가 5월 1일 기업 AI 거버넌스 문제를 해결하기 위한 에이전트 365(Agent 365)를 공식 출시했다. 이 플랫폼은 승인 없이 배포된 비공인 AI 도구, 즉 '섀도우 AI'가 야기하는 보안 위험을 해결한다.

AI 에이전트가 조직 전반에 확산되면서 기업들은 통제되지 않은 에이전트들이 기업 감독 밖에서 운영되는 '에이전트 스프롤' 문제에 직면해 있다. 섀도우 AI 에이전트는 민감한 데이터에 접근하고, 코드를 수정하며, 다른 시스템과 상호작용할 수 있어 데이터 유출 및 무단 접근 위험을 초래한다.

핵심 기능: (1) 관찰 가능성 — IT팀이 마이크로소프트 디펜더와 인튠을 통해 로컬 PC의 에이전트를 포함, 모든 환경의 활성 에이전트를 감지하고 목록화. 향후 GitHub Copilot CLI 및 Claude Code 지원 예정. (2) 거버넌스 — 관리자가 정책 기반 권한과 최소 권한 원칙을 적용하고 컨텍스트 매핑 수행. (3) 보안 — 민감 데이터 유출 및 악의적 행동의 실시간 차단.

에이전트 365는 AWS 베드록과 구글 제미나이 엔터프라이즈와도 통합되어 멀티 클라우드 환경에서 통합 관리를 지원한다.
competitor_articles.keep_reason: MS Agent 365 정식 출시 — 엔터프라이즈 AI 에이전트 거버넌스(섀도우 AI/에이전트 스프롤), AWS Bedrock·Gemini Enterprise 멀티클라우드 통합. AI Agent 생태계 핵심.

competitor_articles.title: Amazon buys office and data center site in Maryland from T. Rowe
competitor_articles.body:
Amazon has acquired an office and data center property in Maryland, purchased from financial services firm T. Rowe Price. The acquisition is part of Amazon Web Services' ongoing expansion of its physical infrastructure footprint in the eastern United States.

AWS operated 56.84 million square feet of data center and office space in 2025, according to regulatory filings. The company's custom chip portfolio—including Graviton CPUs, Trainium AI accelerators, and Nitro DPUs—has surpassed a $20 billion annual revenue run rate, growing at triple-digit rates.

Amazon has deployed more than 2.1 million AI chips over the past year, with Trainium accounting for more than half. AWS and Anthropic have inked a deal to deliver an additional 1 gigawatt of Trainium2 and Trainium3 chips by the end of 2026. The Maryland acquisition adds capacity to support continued growth in its AI infrastructure and cloud services business.
competitor_articles.keep_reason: AWS 자체 실리콘(Nitro DPU·Graviton·Trainium) $20B run-rate 명시 + 1GW Trainium2/3 Anthropic 공급 — MangoBoost DPU 영역 직접 경쟁 맥락.
